Mission
 Ensure the verification and validation of electronic systems and software functionalities through structured testing activities, ensuring compliance with technical requirements, quality standards, and project specifications.
 Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute system test plans, test cases, and validation procedures.
Perform functional, integration, and system-level testing.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and document technical issues.
Collaborate with software, hardware, and system engineering teams to resolve identified problems.
Ensure test coverage and traceability against system requirements.
Support continuous improvement of testing processes and methodologies.
 Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.
Practical experience in system testing and software functionality validation.
Knowledge of electronic systems and software development processes.
 Professional Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
Ability to interpret technical specifications and system requirements.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Good command of technical English.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused mindset.
 SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES is dedicated to gender balance and diversity, recognizing and recruiting talent of all backgrounds.
